description:
While a student at Ateneo de Municipal, Rizal carved the statuette out of batikuling wood. The figure of Jesus Christ sits atop a globe-like structure mounted on an octagonal base, with His hand held close to His Sacred Heart.

The piece remains in good condition, with minor chipping and paint flaking.
condition: Good condition, with minor chipping and paint flaking.
